Mission Local reported that the State Bar sent San Francisco District Attorney Brooke Jenkins to an ethics diversion program over her access to and sharing of a confidential rap sheet for a case she wasn’t handling. The State Bar’s action followed ethics complaints; Mission Local reported that the rap sheet belonged to Troy McAlister and that Jenkins emailed it to a colleague who also had no connection to the case. The April 2025 column also criticized the diversion decision and described Jenkins’ explanation as a tacit admission of breaking the law.
